note: The run-up to the first step. Each entry has a date; the homepage works out on its own what is done, what is next and how many days are left, so nothing here needs touching as time passes. Edit a date and the countdown follows it. Dates are Indian time.

steps.title: Rucksack and tent, bought in the sale
steps.detail: The two things the whole walk sits on, bought while they are cheap rather than in a hurry in November.

steps.title: Turns 21. Resigns the same day.
steps.detail: Birthday in Lucknow, and the last day of the job. The walk stops being a plan that afternoon.

steps.title: Lucknow to Bettiah
steps.detail: Home to West Champaran, to leave behind everything that is not coming to Kanyakumari.

steps.title: Bettiah to Banaras
steps.detail: Out of the hometown, west to the city where the train south begins.

steps.title: The Banaras to Kanyakumari train
steps.detail: The whole country in one direction, by rail, in order to walk back up it.

steps.title: Arrives Kanyakumari
steps.detail: Three days on a train, then a few days standing still on purpose. The legs start the walk rested or not at all.

steps.title: Rameswaram, with sister and grandmother
steps.detail: Family first, before six months of walking away from them.

steps.title: The first step
steps.detail: Vivekananda Rock, Kanyakumari. 4,270 km to Srinagar, on foot.
